title: fix: remove Vector AI Agent from app directory listings
author: YoannDev90
pr_body_excerpt:
Removes Vector AI Agent  as requested by Mincofficial on Discord.

Fixes #12421

gist.headline: A garden bed cleared
gist.blurb: The app garden has one less listing: Vector AI Agent has been retired from the directory. Polli tidied the signpost and kept the paths readable.
gist.summary: Removed the Vector AI Agent entry from apps/catalog.json and the GREENHOUSE app directory listing at the creator's request.
gist.impact: The public app directory now reflects the current set of community projects without the retired Vector AI Agent listing.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community app garden with Polli carefully removing a small retired app sign from a directory board while healthy code-flowers and other project signposts remain. The scene represents accurate curation rather than deletion drama.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, gently taking a small sign labeled 'VECTOR' off a wooden community app directory board while code-flowers bloom nearby.
